title: Towards Measuring and Modeling “Culture” in LLMs: A Survey
findings: Religion is identified as one of several demographic proxies used in studies to evaluate cultural aspects of LLMs. However, it is not a primary focus in the surveyed literature, which tends to concentrate on broader proxies like geographical region and language. The paper notes that persona-driven studies sometimes include religious belief as a demographic attribute to reveal biases and stereotyping.
references: Gati Aher, Rosa I. Arriaga, and Adam Tauman Kalai. 2023. Using large language models to simulate multiple humans and replicate human subject studies.
